signInIntro: Pick up the conversation. Your next trip is a team decision.
signUpIntro: Bring your people. We’ll help you find a route that fits everyone.
forgotIntro: Enter your email. We’ll send you a link to reset your password.
resetIntro: Choose a new password to keep your Tripify account secure.
confirmIntro: Continue below to verify your email and open your account.
storyBody: Research with AI. Weigh the trade-offs. Decide together.
name: Your name
passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. A longer, unique passphrase is better.
privacyNote: Your password is handled by Supabase Auth. Trip changes still need a human decision.
missing: Authentication is not configured yet. Add the Supabase project URL and publishable key to enable sign-in.
invalidCredentials: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, and confirm your email if needed.
network: We couldn’t connect. Check your connection and try again.
generic: We couldn’t complete this request. Please try again.
rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
weakPassword: This password does not meet the account security requirements. Try a longer, unique password.
googleError: Google sign-in was cancelled or could not be completed. Try again or use email.
sent: If this address is eligible, a confirmation email is on its way. Open it to continue. Already registered? Sign in instead.
resetSent: If this address has an account, a password reset email is on its way.
spam: Check your spam folder too. Only the latest valid link should be used.
expired: This link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new email or try signing in.
dashboardIntro: You’re signed in. This is your account entry point; trip creation is coming in the next development phase.
signOutError: We couldn’t sign you out. Please try again.
